content.title: WHAT DOCTORS DON'T WANT YOU TO KNOW ABOUT YOUR {{EVENING}} HABITS
facts: **Cold water on your wrists** for 30 seconds before bed — this cools your core temperature and signals your brain it's time to fall asleep faster.
**Chew each bite 20 times** at dinner — this slows digestion, lowers bloating, and helps you feel full on less food.
**Walk for 10 minutes** right after eating — this pulls glucose out of your bloodstream and prevents the post-meal energy crash.
**Write down 1 worry** before bed on paper — this empties your mind so cortisol doesn't spike at 3am.
**Stand up every 45 minutes** during work — this keeps blood flowing and prevents stiffness in your hips and lower back.
**Breathe out longer than you breathe in** for 2 minutes — this shifts your nervous system out of fight-or-flight instantly.
**Dim the lights 1 hour before bed** — this lets melatonin rise naturally instead of being blocked by bright light.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these tiny habits do more than they look like on the surface. Cold water on your wrists works because your wrists sit close to major blood vessels, so cooling them helps drop your core temperature — one of the strongest natural sleep triggers your body has. Walking for just 10 minutes after eating activates your leg muscles to soak up glucose directly from your blood, which is why so many people feel sleepy and foggy after meals when they skip it. And that longer exhale trick isn't just relaxation talk — it directly stimulates your vagus nerve, which tells your whole nervous system to calm down. Everyone's body responds a little differently, so pay attention to what actually shifts how you feel.
